DESCRIPTION
A pendant spotlight with a powder coated metal body and solid metal detailing. The pendant features our signature solid metal cross-knurl baffle and machined screws. The baffle captures light and creates a delicate metallic glow, whilst a honeycomb filter delivers a precise, low-glare, directional spotlight. This spotlight fits a GU10 bulb, sold separately.
